verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud lets you hand an agent a goal via `client.runs.create(...)` and let it execute autonomously on managed cloud browsers. You then poll `runs.events()` to monitor progress, which implies asynchronous background execution. Saved login profiles and automatic CAPTCHA solving reduce the need for a human in the loop. However, the evidence shows only one-off, API-triggered runs, not set-up-once automations that recur or trigger on their own. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/recurring or event-triggered automations, completion notifications or callbacks (only polling is shown), and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended background operation.
